data.description:
## Goal

Implement the two acquisition gates in `src/MainStreetAiStrategy.ts`
(work item MS-0MV5VOIV40020KXT) and update `docs/main-street/ai-strategy.md`.

## Scope

1. **Predicates** — small named helpers with doc comments referencing the work
   item: `hasIncomeStream(state, playerId?)` (seat owns a placed business with
   `baseIncome > 0`) and `ownsUpgradeTarget(state, card, playerId?)`
   (`name === targetBusiness`, `level === requiredLevel`, `level < maxLevel`).
2. **Single-player gate** — in `scoreMarketAcquisition` / the acquisition path:
   - business: skip `move-to-hand` when effective cost
     (`computeEffectiveBusinessPurchaseCost`) > coins AND no income stream;
   - upgrade: skip unless `ownsUpgradeTarget`.
3. **Competitive mirror** — same gates in the `move-to-hand` branch of
   `scoreCompetitiveAction` and in `competitiveBestMarketAcquisitionValue`,
   with ownership via `getSlotOwnerId` / `competitiveUpgradeTargets`.
4. Keep `RandomStrategy` unchanged (gating is scoring-side, enumeration
   untouched).
5. Update `docs/main-street/ai-strategy.md` (and any README/docs entries that
   reference the acquisition heuristic) describing both gates, defining
   "income stream", "affordable" and "owns the target business".

## Acceptance Criteria

- Gated `move-to-hand` actions are never emitted by GreedyStrategy,
  BankingGreedyStrategy, or CompetitiveGreedyStrategy (AC1–AC5 of the parent).
- Affordable business / unaffordable-but-income / owned-target upgrade are
  still taken as before (no regression, AC4).
- Monte Carlo guardrails for greedy and banking-greedy pass; any drift is
  reported on the work item (AC7).
- Full project test suite passes (AC8).
- Determinism: no new RNG (constraint).
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **MS-0MUMCVH3N007KT1M** – Implement IT Specialist and Delivery Driver cost-reduction effects (completed)
- **MS-0MUI7ZJK8003HY9J** – Sell 3 businesses challenge (blocked)
- **MS-0MV5I4P3G007EV1Q** – Update upgrade-rendering documentation (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `core/docs/DEVELOPER.md` — matched: ac4, ac5, acceptance, actions, affordable (+85 more)
- `docs/main-street/ai-strategy.md` — matched: ac1, ac4, ac5, acceptance, acquisition (+77 more)
- `docs/main-street/prd-milestone-3.md` — matched: acceptance, actions, affordable, baseincome, branch (+70 more)
